pages.title: Immutable Sequences
pages.content: Tuples are like lists, but they cannot be changed after creation (immutable). Use parentheses `()` instead of square brackets. Tuples are faster than lists and useful when data shouldn't change.

pages.title: Working with Tuples
pages.code:
coordinates = (10, 20)
colors = ("red", "green", "blue")

print(coordinates[0])  # 10
print(len(colors))     # 3

# Unpacking
x, y = coordinates
print(x)  # 10
print(y)  # 20

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: Can you modify a tuple after creating it?
pages.explanation: Tuples are immutable — you cannot add, remove, or change items after creation.
